comment: The OSDF folders the tutorials read. 'path' is below the public namespace /fno4hic; each folder holds the .js_transfer_crc32c.json manifest of js_osdf.py, from which get_data.py lists and checks the files. 'include' picks files by glob (default: all). 'planned' sets are not uploaded yet. The v1 sets will live under tutorials/v1/ and are never overwritten; the interim sets point at the existing test and example folders.

oo_test.description: Three O+O events of the Pythonic workflow (oo_workflow.xml): the bulk hadrons (20 oversamples each) and the jet fragments.

hadron_read_test.description: One Au+Au 0-10% bulk_jet hadron file, for reader tests.

auau_jet_event.description: One Au+Au 0-10% jet event at 200 GeV: the hydro pair (arr, arr_bg), the particlize file, bulk_jet and jet_frag hadrons (no bulk_bg).

auau_hadrons_root.description: A Au+Au 0-10% jet campaign (pT-hat 10-40 GeV) converted to ROOT: 60 per-job files and the campaign file. Use --max-files to take a few.

auau_pair_mini.description: One Au+Au 0-10% background with ~5 jets, every file of the jobs: pair, particlize, bulk_jet, bulk_bg, jet_frag, ROOT, records.

oo_mini.description: 10-20 O+O events with every file, ROOT included.

auau_stats.description: 50-100 Au+Au hadron-level events in 2-3 pT-hat windows, HDF5 and ROOT.

pp_ref.description: The vacuum (pp) jet reference in the same pT-hat windows as auau_stats.

derived.description: Precomputed campaign summaries: wake_observables.h5, wake_hadrons.h5, extra_hard_hists.npz.
